Code read on integriq origin/development 254619dff, openregister origin/development 26ff809cfb, pipelinq origin/development. Folded into capabilities.json by the lane's fold script (built.state, built.evidence, built.change, built.readOn, the integriq rating, reachedOn).

entries.cap: Let citizens log in with DigiD through a broker.
entries.evidence: The browser half is built and archived (openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-29-identity-broker-browser-login, 9 of 11 tasks ticked; the two open ones are the strict run and the portaliq live walk): appinfo/routes.php:402-404 idpBroker#start and #callback for digid|eherkenning|eidas, lib/Controller/IdpBrokerController.php:147 start() and :192 callback(), lib/Auth/Idp/IdpLoginService.php. The container binds GovernmentIdpAdapterInterface to LogGovernmentIdpAdapter only (lib/AppInfo/Application.php:591-596), and that adapter throws on every call (lib/Auth/Idp/LogGovernmentIdpAdapter.php:93 beginAuthentication and :109 readAssertion both end in refuse() at :128), so start() catches the refusal at IdpBrokerController.php:159 and no citizen gets logged in. Missing: the vendor SAML Service Provider or OIDC Relying Party adapter, which openspec/changes/portal-idp-broker-config carries and which is blocked on Open Decisions D1 to D5 (broker vendor and contract).
entries.reachedOn: GET /apps/integriq/api/idp/digid/start exists and answers with a refusal: the only bound adapter is LogGovernmentIdpAdapter

entries.cap: Let companies log in with eHerkenning.
entries.evidence: Same path as id-digid, archived in openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-29-identity-broker-browser-login: appinfo/routes.php:402-404 accept eherkenning, lib/Controller/IdpBrokerController.php:147 and :192, and an eHerkenning envelope carries the vestigingsnummer as branch (lib/Auth/Idp/SubjectEnvelope.php:69). The only bound adapter is LogGovernmentIdpAdapter (lib/AppInfo/Application.php:591-596), which refuses every call (lib/Auth/Idp/LogGovernmentIdpAdapter.php:93, :109, :128). Missing: the vendor adapter in openspec/changes/portal-idp-broker-config, blocked on Open Decisions D1 to D5.
entries.reachedOn: GET /apps/integriq/api/idp/eherkenning/start exists and answers with a refusal: the only bound adapter is LogGovernmentIdpAdapter

entries.cap: Pick from hundreds of ready-made connectors for common business software.
entries.evidence: The change is archived with every task ticked (openspec/changes/archive/2026-09-29-connectors-catalogue-expansion/tasks.md, 10 of 10; shipped in 6bdb8bdae). The mechanism is in the tree: a pinned APIs.guru snapshot (lib/Settings/connector-templates/saas/snapshot/index.json), a reviewed allow-list (lib/Settings/connector-templates/saas/allow-list.json, 2 entries: Google Sheets, Slack), scripts/generate-connector-templates.php and scripts/ConnectorTemplateGenerator.php, curated templates (saas/salesforce-rest.json, backoffice/alfresco-cmis.json), read by lib/Service/Catalog/ConnectorTemplateLibrary.php:30 and listed by lib/Service/CatalogRegistryService.php:233 collectFromTemplates(); the Store shows them under the 'Generated templates' tier (src/manifest.json:4426-4428). Rated partial, not yes: the Store holds about 40 cards, not hundreds; growing it is data (allow-list entries), not code, and no change schedules that growth.
entries.reachedOn: /store, tier 'Generated templates', plus the source-template cards from lib/Settings/register.d

entries.cap: Look up companies abroad through OpenCorporates.
entries.evidence: OpenRegister built and archived the lookup (openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-05-integration-kvk-opencorporates, 11 tasks ticked, none open): openregister appinfo/routes.php:929 companyLookup#openCorporatesSearch GET /api/integrations/opencorporates/search, lib/Controller/CompanyLookupController.php:150 openCorporatesSearch(), lib/Service/Integration/Providers/OpenCorporatesProvider.php:73 SOURCE_ID 'opencorporates' routed through the source integriq seeds. Integriq ships that source: lib/Settings/register.d/opencorporates-source.json:9 slug opencorporates, :20 configuration.mock true, :52 isEnabled true. A user reaches the search in pipelinq: lib/Service/OpenCorporatesApiClient.php:213 calls the OpenRegister endpoint, used by lib/Service/ProspectDiscoveryService.php. Rated partial: integriq's source answers with a canned mock until an admin adds an api_token and removes the mock flag, and integriq has no screen of its own for the search.
entries.reachedOn: pipelinq prospect discovery through GET /apps/openregister/api/integrations/opencorporates/search over integriq's opencorporates source; in integriq, /store (source-template:opencorporates) and /sources

entries.evidence: OpenRegister built and archived the query search (openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-05-integration-xwiki-query-search, 10 tasks ticked, none open): openregister appinfo/routes.php:915 xwikiLinks#search GET /api/integrations/xwiki/search, lib/Controller/XwikiLinksController.php:303 search(), next to the object-linked routes at :914-918 and lib/Service/Integration/Providers/XwikiProvider.php. Integriq ships the source it reads through: lib/Settings/register.d/xwiki-source.json:9 slug xwiki, :21 isEnabled false with a dev-stack placeholder location. pipelinq calls the search: lib/Service/XWikiService.php:229 searchViaOpenRegister(), served by lib/Controller/XWikiController.php. Rated partial: integriq's source ships disabled with a placeholder URL, so nothing reads pages until an admin sets the real location and enables it, and integriq has no screen of its own for wiki pages.
entries.reachedOn: pipelinq's XWikiController search through GET /apps/openregister/api/integrations/xwiki/search, and OpenRegister's object xWiki links, over integriq's xwiki source; in integriq, /store (source-template:xwiki) and /sources
